findings.title: Hold fog bank body shifted down: the massif foot F420 hides is more exposed than in MAIN (Q14)
findings.evidence: x120-320, F420 aligned +5 px (row-gradient correlation). Bank body rows 500-520: LANE 137-155 vs F420 157-168 vs MAIN 151-164 in all 4 sampled hold frames (harness qc_final p06; deterministic t=40 expand 2.97 and 2.50; t=25 expand 2.97). Mean |d| vs F420 over rows 440-600: harness 6.0 -> 8.9, t=25 6.5 -> 9.2 (worse); t=40 9.1 -> 8.8, expand 2.50 8.2 -> 7.9 (slightly better). Gains: the face above the bank is darker like F420 (rows 460-480 122-142 vs F420 121-140, MAIN 132-152) and the bank has puffs (sd 8-11 -> 13-19, F420 15-24). Panel environment item 5 asked for a bank that hides the massif foot; the lane hides less of it. Images: an/p06_bank_det.png (F420 | MAIN t40 | LANE t40 | MAIN t25 | LANE t25), an/leftbank_p06_sustain.png, an/bank_p06_boost.png. The builder saw it (LOG 06:36) and reverted a +0.8 m fix.
findings.repro: node tools/cap.mjs 5178 caps/lane_hold tools/plan_hold.json and the same on 5173 into caps/main_hold (judge WORK); BPY python -I tools/holda.py and tools/align.py. Or compare qc_final/p06_sustain.png rows 480-540 x120-320 with ref_F420.png rows 485-545.

Give the release split its own sub-switch, so ?fogbank=r11 is not the only way back.

perf: REST (judge run, T1 real RAF loop, vsync off, interleaved A=:5173 / B=:5178, 6 pairs, SLOT_BG=0): paired median B/A of run medians 0.952, of run means 0.970; pairs at load < 10: 6 (0.952 / 0.970). The run overlapped another judge's perf run (judge_p4ice3:perf) and judge_p4env3:ab2. Frame times were bimodal (23-54 ms) and the pair ratios ran from 0.59 to 1.64, so this is weak evidence. It still shows no regression above 5 %, consistent with the builder's rest 0.993 and hold 1.020 (paired) and with the code's cost (the waterline mist touches ~1.7 % of the frame at rest; no pass or target was added). The builder's perf files were re-read and their paired medians reproduce.
not_regressions: Checked and not worse: the rest frames at matched times (berg, left bases, massif, far bergs unchanged), consecutive-frame pulsing (rest and hold sustain, per-pixel |dI| lane <= MAIN), the release (monotonic, no pop), 5 pointer orbits, the 34-frame sweep, T0 pixels, and the 0 console messages.
